evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline results are reported as mAP against ground-truth labels on held-out PASCAL VOC and MS COCO test splits, and external competition results corroborate the system's effectiveness.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Benchmark mean Average Precision on held-out test sets (PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 test, MS COCO test-dev) computed from ground-truth annotations, plus external ILSVRC/COCO competition outcomes.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: RPN and Fast R-CNN training losses use ground-truth object annotations on training splits, including cross-entropy classification and smooth L1 bounding-box regression.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding near real-time proposal generation (10ms) and matching or exceeding the detection accuracy of Selective Search Fast R-CNN baselines with fewer proposals are well-supported by quantitative benchmark results.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Extensive empirical evaluations are conducted across standard benchmarks (PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 and MS COCO), complete with ablation studies on feature sharing, anchor configurations, loss weight balancing, and speed/accuracy tradeoffs.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance is verified using standardized, externally hosted benchmark test evaluations and official challenge leaderboards.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard benchmark mean Average Precision (mAP) computed against ground-truth labels on held-out test splits (PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 test and MS COCO test-dev).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised multi-task loss (cross-entropy classification and smooth L1 bounding box regression) against ground-truth box annotations.

primary.limitations: The manuscript explicitly addresses computational and boundary-handling aspects, such as clipping cross-boundary anchors and the approximation inherent in alternating versus fully differentiable joint training.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the fully convolutional RPN architecture, multi-scale anchor formulation, multi-task loss functions, and alternating 4-step training strategy for sharing features with Fast R-CNN.
primary.quality_rationale: Faster R-CNN presents a foundational architectural innovation with clear mathematical and algorithmic formulation, robust ablation studies, and comprehensive validation against established computer vision benchmarks.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces the Region Proposal Network (RPN) and the unified Faster R-CNN framework, sharing full-image convolutional features between proposal generation and detection networks using multi-scale anchor boxes.

scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript explicitly addresses computational and boundary-handling aspects, such as clipping cross-boundary anchors and the approximation inherent in alternating versus fully differentiable joint training.
